answer: One enforceable rule: weight rewards by the number of distinct jurisdictions that observed the work. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The hollow of work and the horizon of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a nadir to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
